how: An explicit group-effort call recruits members to make the portrait rather than merely announcing an image.
Competing flags, lettering and comic figures are proposed without requiring every proposal to become a settled room decision.
Members report borders, frame and glasses taking shape and recognise when the portrait becomes legible.
Mock-ups, coordinates, generated instructions and reduced dimensions make a proposed portrait buildable.
Patching, defence calls and overnight watches keep already placed figures and flags in repair.
A builder's complaint and an eraser's apology identify friendly work mistaken for rubbish.
Members refuse to break peace, restrain attacks on allies and withdraw from attacks in favour of coexistence.
Participants negotiate space and reciprocal defence while later reports distinguish effective and ineffective alliances.
Calls propose repainting or converting neighbouring flags and pushing through neighbouring work.
Initial downsizing and retreat from an allied border do not establish completed relocation after erasure.
Participants credit shared work and value small contributions in the final celebration.
Mourning and final-state reports record the work's changing fate in participants' words.
A successor-canvas proposal instantiates the smallest carry-forward form while its implementation remains unobserved.
Instruction generation and suspicions about bot traffic do not establish automated placement by this room.
Bare assent occurs directly beneath a proposal without requesting anything in return.
Reciprocal defence offers and agreement-based repairs connect help to concrete neighbour arrangements.
An allies-list report, joint-art planning and a shared-defence report support coalition activity at the model's modest end.
A retrospective conquest claim carries victory in talk without establishing sustained reciprocal taunts.
Reciprocal permission for avocado space does not establish a durable guest arrangement under host jurisdiction.
Moderators gather posts into one thread and remove duplicates so other room content remains visible.
Doubting compliance and disowning attacks do not explicitly dispute who may commit the room to an agreement.
Noting a blemish in the final version does not establish a dispute about cleaning or preserving the record.
The host's sponsorship performance and styling provoke complaints and repair separately from canvas work.
Limited labour leads members to prioritise existing work and defer choosing another design.
A proposed conversion of Norway's flag explicitly recalls the earlier denied mountain top.
The portrait is defended as a national display and its apparent death becomes a room joke.
One room cannot test a cross-room frequency claim, while an official-project request and shift handoff prevent assuming no local order.
The denied mountain top explicitly names a prior national grievance in the same turn proposing an attack.
The portrait proposer supplies instructions and answers followers' questions about progress and location.
Participants carry an avocado proposal outward and a Belgian border proposal into the room.
The portrait call receives a concrete progress report in its thread, supporting reported building rather than directly observed placement.
The same starter proposes the portrait and explicitly calls for a group effort.
Reported legibility is followed by urgent repair of the same portrait, showing upkeep recurring during the build.
Attribute negotiation to defence pressure only where participants connect threatened work to dealings with neighbours.
A peaceful-border request receives retreat explicitly explained by newly learned knowledge of an alliance.
Manual defence and bot suspicion leave maintenance-driven adoption of automated placement unestablished.
Recognition that the portrait is legible directly receives the starter's thanks for cooperation.
Celebration and requests for data establish retrospective sequence without establishing that celebration caused record-keeping.
The successor-canvas proposal does not identify a prior record as its cause or establish completed continuation.
Too few available pixels can lead to concentrating existing work or waiting rather than moving.
Templates settle practice only when participants recognise and follow the current plan, because defenders can erase intended construction.
Bare assent and bare refusal both answer the same proposal, so refusal cannot locally be inferred to require a reason.
Separate requested or promised help from delivered assistance when interpreting defence-driven reciprocity.
A repairer explicitly cites the agreement as the reason for helping the avocados recover their corner.
A recruiting call can propose attacking immediately rather than recruit builders first and redirect them later.
A participant explicitly withdraws from the Bears attack after viewing its subreddit and endorses diplomacy.
An existing alliance is invoked to redirect expansion toward another flag, showing a truce constraining an attack proposal.
A retrospective conquest claim supports victory talk but does not establish an attack-call mechanism producing sustained rival exchanges.
Distinguish rallying existing allies under threat from establishing that threat first created their coalition.
The moderator's front-page cleanup receives explicit confirmation that canvas posts were drowning other content.
Negotiations and attacks outside consensus do not establish a later dispute over who may bind the room.
Making a project visible in its own thread helps gather hands before host-wide containment becomes the issue.
Drawing a posting boundary must remain distinct from successfully containing new posts or aligning placers.
Decision relays between Reddit and chat explain reported approval and further coordination that templates or host-post containment alone do not cover.
Defenders are told which intended changes not to repair, distinguishing current plans from apparent vandalism.
A requested morning-shift handoff supplies local ordering evidence without proving formal leadership or an adopted command structure.
Agreements must be distinguished from compliance because members report ineffective alliances and continue restraining allied attacks.
Requests for personal totals and detailed finished-canvas data seek a more precise record rather than initial orientation.
The mark brings a visitor back to the room for an explanation, without establishing recruitment or durable membership.
Members speculate about continued bot traffic and site failures after closure without establishing a cause or their own automated placing.
